content.comment_body: I am attempting to use the example you attached, but I'm unable to download it. Could you share screenshots of the tag tables, screens, and settings for the buttons involved?
The download link is working; I've tested it and it functions properly. What issues are you experiencing when trying to download?
I'm not sure. I can download the other file in the archive without issue, but can't download the TIA project. I'm using [version_no], which matches the version you referenced.

Both files—the program and the [version_no] project—are included in the same ZIP folder. If you can download one file, you should also be able to access the [version_no] project. Could you clarify your specific problem?

Sorry for any confusion. Putting aside the download issue, could you provide screenshots showing how the tags are set up and how they're configured within the properties section of your implementation?
Excuse me, but do you think I'm not busy or have nothing else to do?
I didn't mean to offend; I know you're occupied. I was just wondering if it was possible. Apologies for the trouble—I'll work on this myself. Thank you very much for your help, and have a good day.

analysis.insight_summary: A user faced challenges accessing a TIA project example—even though other files in the same archive were downloadable—and requested screenshots that clarified configuration. The conversation exposed gaps in documentation and possible confusion regarding file contents, highlighting how incomplete support materials and unclear file organization can create difficulties, both technical and communicative, for users seeking help.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want straightforward access to project example files and additional resources like screenshots that detail configuration and setup steps, supporting easier understanding and integration of the solution.
